caveats: The original frozen baseline, targetedRetests and patchedEstimate remain unchanged. Unretested outcomes are assumed unchanged; regressions outside these URLs remain possible.
The 249-case audit used one clean revision and four workers, verified by before/after source fingerprints. Later focused results replace only their exact URLs and carry separate revision identifiers.

The 120-second controller budget does not change official testharness deadlines. Three long NodeList stress cases passed their assertions but exceeded the harness deadline under four-worker load; the original failures remain recorded.
Global ErrorEvent reporting is now enabled: script registration errors are visible to the ordinary testharness. Passing artifacts were also checked for missing frozen-baseline subtest names.

Real XHTML and ordinary XML iframe navigation now pass their separately recorded factory cases. Unrelated incomplete SVG and worker cases, including four URLPattern worker wrappers, are not counted as complete passes.
The frozen baseline ran on Android ARM64, while this retest runs Linux ARM64 with a different Bun canary revision. Timing and runtime differences remain.
The whole-manifest number is a mixed-results estimate against all 131,953 cases, not a fresh full-manifest run.

One frozen font-shorthand-subproperties-reset pass now registers zero tests and is counted as a nonpass. All conditional CSS.supports gates were already false in the exact pre-font HEAD comparison; this is not attributed to c279d4d.

The font-family, KeyboardEvent and XHR checks ran in a concurrent working tree. Independent paint-damage edits in page-renderer.js, video-mask.js and test/fixtures/canvas-damage.js are excluded from the functional commits.
